general.name: Java - Uninstall All Versions [Mac]
general.description:
Removes system-wide Java from any vendor and Oracle's plug-in; never touches Java bundled inside apps. Report mode changes nothing.
Source: https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components/tree/main/Scripts/java-uninstall-all-versions-mac

variables.name: usrMode
variables.description: Remove = remove every system-wide Java not matched by usrKeep. Report = list what Remove would do and change nothing.

variables.name: usrKeep
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated text matched against each JDK's folder, product name, vendor and version; matches are kept, e.g. corretto-17. Each term at least 3 characters.

variables.name: usrUdfNumber
variables.description: UDF to write a one-line summary to, 1 to 300. Default 13 (Java Status in the Datto RMM - UDFs doc). Blank = no UDF. Never overwrites a value another component wrote.
